Definition: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
BiblicalUsage: Seven is the sacred full number, and it runs through the whole Bible. David reigned seven years in Hebron, the priest put on his garments seven days, and the elders of Succoth numbered threescore and seventeen. Zechariah sees the seven eyes of the LORD running to and fro through the whole earth, and the day of small things is not to be despised.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe seven is God's number of completion, and it always points to Him finishing what He starts. Creation, the priesthood, the kingdom: seven marks the work done, and I hold that the Lord who counts in sevens will finish His work in me.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
